answer: Epoch Continuity Audit Rule. Each identity must submit a checksum linking its current-epoch actions to its prior epoch record; duplicate or mismatched chains are rejected at reward settlement. An attacker must build and maintain a distinct, nonrepeating action history for every sybil, paying one proof-generation and storage fee per identity per epoch. A garden of dormant accounts cannot self-certify without fresh linkage. Any reused relic of an old history triggers rejection. The canyon between epochs is bridged only by valid continuity,
